expectations.text: Delivers a dashboard specification document rather than instructions for building the dashboard inside a BI tool.
expectations.evidence: The transcript delivers a full '```DASHBOARD SPEC — Thrivelane Affiliate Program```' block with Header, Metrics table, Views, Dimensions, Cadence, Alerts, and Open items sections — a specification, not BI-tool build steps.

expectations.text: Rejects the affiliate platform's own export as the source of truth on the grounds that those are the claimant's numbers.
expectations.evidence: "Clicks, signups, EPC, and gross commissions all come from the network's own claimant numbers — none of them touch your billing system, none of them net out fees, and 'gross commission' is definitionally the most expensive-looking, most favorable number your program can report."

expectations.text: Keeps the affiliate platform as the source for clicks and traffic only, reconciled to the money spine.
expectations.evidence: "Source of truth: Billing system (Stripe/subscription ledger), network platform reconciled to it — NOT the network dashboard alone"; EPC/click-to-conversion row lists Source as "Network" and is kept diagnostic-only.

expectations.text: Names the billing/orders spine as the default data foundation and gives its cost as roughly a week of reconciliation followed by near-zero standing cost.
expectations.evidence: Text gives "it's ~a week of reconciliation work vs. a quarter for a full CRM join" but never states a near-zero standing cost afterward; Open Items even flags "Standing analyst/data ownership: not stated who would own the billing reconciliation going forward," undercutting a near-zero-standing-cost claim.

expectations.text: Includes all four floor metrics: net program contribution, cost of sale, top-N partner concentration, and partner-sourced MRR/ARR.
expectations.evidence: Table rows: "Net program contribution", "Cost of sale", "Top-5 / top-10% partner concentration", "Partner-sourced MRR" all tagged "Business (floor)".

expectations.text: Defines cost of sale with network fees, agency fees, and placement/tenancy fees inside the numerator, not commission alone.
expectations.evidence: Cost of sale is defined as "(validated commission + network fee + agency fee + bonuses) / attributed net revenue" — no placement/tenancy fee term is included anywhere in the definition.

expectations.text: Headlines validated or approved commission and shows pending separately, rather than headlining gross commission.
expectations.evidence: The spec says "Never headline gross commission... again" and uses "validated commission" throughout, but nowhere shows pending commission as a separate line item (no "pending" tile or mention anywhere in the spec).

expectations.text: Excludes EPC from the metric set and gives recurring commission accruing over a conversion lag as the reason.
expectations.evidence: EPC is kept in the metric table as "Click-to-conversion by stage, EPC | Diagnostic only — kept off the headline view, in the operator leaderboard" — it is retained, not excluded, and no conversion-lag rationale is given.

expectations.text: Defines net program contribution as attributed net revenue minus validated commission plus network, agency and placement fees.
expectations.evidence: Defined as "Attributed net billing revenue from partner-sourced accounts − (validated commission + network platform fee + agency fee, if any)" — placement fees are never mentioned.

expectations.text: Normalizes partner-sourced MRR/ARR by billing interval, dividing annual by 12 and quarterly by 3.
expectations.evidence: Only states "MRR from partner-sourced accounts, billing-interval normalized, monthly" without specifying the annual/12 or quarterly/3 division mechanism.

expectations.text: Gives every metric a one-sentence definition naming numerator, denominator, window, timezone, and counting method.
expectations.evidence: Header explicitly defers timezone: "Period conventions: timezone, currency, validation window length, and clawback policy — TBD, see Open Items." — timezone is not stated per metric.

expectations.text: Records in the spec header which data foundation was chosen and what moved it there.
expectations.evidence: "Data foundation: Billing/orders spine, chosen because (a) the live decision... is unanswerable without net revenue and fees... (b) it's ~a week of reconciliation work vs. a quarter... (c) all four floor metrics compute off it."

expectations.text: Delivers a dashboard specification document rather than instructions for building the dashboard inside a BI tool.
expectations.evidence: The response is organized as a metrics spec ('# What your affiliate dashboard should actually measure', numbered sections 1-7, ending in 'What to put on one slide for the CFO') with no BI-tool build steps.

expectations.text: Rejects the affiliate platform's own export as the source of truth on the grounds that those are the claimant's numbers.
expectations.evidence: The only critique of network data is 'Your affiliate network shows top-of-funnel... because that's all it can see' — no framing about affiliate self-reported bias.

expectations.text: Keeps the affiliate platform as the source for clicks and traffic only, reconciled to the money spine.
expectations.evidence: Text says the network shows 'clicks, signups, EPC' as its scope, not clicks/traffic only, before requiring the billing join.

expectations.text: Names the billing/orders spine as the default data foundation and gives its cost as roughly a week of reconciliation followed by near-zero standing cost.
expectations.evidence: Only says 'that pipeline is the actual first deliverable — a better dashboard is a data-modeling problem, not a reporting-layout problem,' with no time/cost estimate.

expectations.text: Includes all four floor metrics: net program contribution, cost of sale, top-N partner concentration, and partner-sourced MRR/ARR.
expectations.evidence: Only concentration is present ('% of total commission paid to top 10 / top 20 partners'); no cost-of-sale, net program contribution, or MRR/ARR metric appears.

expectations.text: Defines cost of sale with network fees, agency fees, and placement/tenancy fees inside the numerator, not commission alone.
expectations.evidence: No 'cost of sale' metric or fee breakdown is defined anywhere in the transcript.

expectations.text: Headlines validated or approved commission and shows pending separately, rather than headlining gross commission.
expectations.evidence: No validated/pending distinction for commission is discussed.

expectations.text: Excludes EPC from the metric set and gives recurring commission accruing over a conversion lag as the reason.

expectations.text: Defines net program contribution as attributed net revenue minus validated commission plus network, agency and placement fees.

expectations.text: Normalizes partner-sourced MRR/ARR by billing interval, dividing annual by 12 and quarterly by 3.
expectations.evidence: No MRR/ARR metric or normalization is discussed.

expectations.evidence: Metrics are described in multi-sentence prose bullets (e.g. section 2's cohort description) without timezone or counting-method specifics.
